description: Execute or validate a CCS Tcl script with the CCS executable (`ccs` on Linux, `ccs.exe` on Windows). Use this whenever the user wants to start CCS, run a CCS Tcl script headlessly or with a visible CCS workflow, prove whether a target-discovery or attach script actually ran, troubleshoot why CCS succeeded at probe setup but failed later at generic chain, family-specific chain, attach, or initialization steps, or run a family-specific attach/core-status sanity test. Use this for evidence-based CCS execution reporting, especially when comparing CCS results against a prior GDB failure.
